about: What the resting triage (tools/usd/triage.py) reads as data rather than code: which inventory groups and kit kind groups stand fixed in the kit's frame (a kit kind in the group `hangs` or `floors` is part of the room's shell, laid by the kit), which row ids are a kit piece's glowing part (judged with its host, as the game's scene check does), which words make a row hang, and which things may bed into what they lie on, how deep. Words match whole words of a row's id and name. The bedding classes come from the game 2099's scene check (tools/scenecheck/resting.gd, 2026-10-08: a cable drop through its skirting, a pillow on a tilted back pad, a tea towel over a handle, rocks and debris in the ground).
